source.trial: SGLT2 inhibitor systematic review and meta-analysis (17 RCTs, 23,523 patients)
source.citation: SGLT2 Inhibitors, Functional Capacity, and Quality of Life in Patients With Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. JAMA Netw Open 2024

rows.population: All-EF pool (mean LVEF 43.5%); dominated by DAPA-HF, EMPEROR-Reduced, DEFINE-HF, DETERMINE-Reduced for this band
rows.quote: SGLT2i use was associated with increased KCCQ-TSS (MD, 2.28 points; 95% CI, 1.74-2.81 points; P < .001), KCCQ-CSS (MD, 2.14 points; 95% CI, 1.53-2.74 points; P < .001), and KCCQ-OSS (MD, 1.90 points; 95% CI, 1.41-2.39 points; P < .001) scores.
rows.notes: Pooled over 9 studies, 17,598 patients, follow-up 3 to 12 months, all LVEF (mean 43.5%). Full text: no significant subgroup interaction for KCCQ-12 outcomes by baseline LVEF, SGLT2i used, or follow-up time; no significant heterogeneity. Single published pooled estimate with an interval; the three band rows share it because band-specific pooled intervals sit in the paper's supplement, which I could not retrieve. Trial-level rows for each band are below.

source.citation: Effects of Dapagliflozin on Symptoms, Function, and Quality of Life in Patients With Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction: Results From the DAPA-HF Trial. Circulation 2020

rows.quote: [components] FAIR-HF/CONFIRM-HF week 24 OSS 4.45 [95% CI 2.19; 6.72]; AFFIRM-AHF week 24 OSS 3.0 (0.3-5.6)
rows.notes: Arithmetic: SE1=(6.72-2.19)/3.92=1.156 (w=0.748), SE2=(5.6-0.3)/3.92=1.352 (w=0.547); pooled = (4.45*0.748+3.0*0.547)/1.295 = 3.84; SE=1/sqrt(1.295)=0.878; 95% CI 3.84 +/- 1.72 = 2.12 to 5.56. Mixes chronic stable and post-acute populations and a pooled-with-trial input; the two inputs are independent trials. Basis labeled trial because the inputs are trials, not a published meta-analysis.

rows.population: Chronic HF, LVEF below 40, 3,010 patients, valsartan added to ACEi/beta-blocker background
rows.quote: Valsartan had a significant beneficial effect on the least-square mean change in overall MLWHF score from baseline to study endpoint (+/- standard error) (average followup 23.0 months) compared with placebo (0.19 +/- 0.47 versus 1.94 +/- 0.48; P = .005 respectively).

source.citation: Effect of Finerenone on the KCCQ in Patients With HFmrEF/HFpEF: A Prespecified Analysis of FINEARTS-HF. J Am Coll Cardiol 2025
